population: All 213 strict-QC 2026 JJAS forecast-only leads from the sealed 122-cycle prediction archive; every valid IMD 03-03 UTC regional grid cell paired identically across M0-M4
reference_clearance_required: 2026_imd_reference_clearance_v1.json with SHA-256, source receipt, authorized local use and 03:00-03:00 UTC window
model_version_clearance_required: 2026_gefs_version_clearance_v1.json with authoritative transition evidence and reviewed comparability
frozen_primary: M4 minus M2 heavy-rain CSI, two-sided 97.5-percent date-block bootstrap; all paired cells, no post-outcome filtering
frozen_secondary: M3 minus M2 heavy-rain CSI on identical cells
frozen_promotion_gates: M4 heavy CSI adjusted lower interval above zero
M4 minus M2 RMSE at most +0.2 mm
absolute M4 mean error at most 1.5 mm
probability_population_rule: Exclude complete leads with frozen P(very heavy)>P(heavy) from probability metrics only; retain them for deterministic M0-M4 comparisons; never project or tune on 2026 outcomes
reporting: forecast-regime argmax with no expert-truth claim
